- CLONED conv-state/activations = flat index_select gather of the per-layer activation rings `_fr13_replay_ring_k/v/a/b` (k pre-l2norm, v, raw_a, raw_b at consumed dtype; staged at fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:4824-4835) at the chain node indices.

d.nativeRefKernel: Native `fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update` (vllm/model_executor/layers/fla/ops/fused_sigmoid_gating.py:195) is invoked observe-only via a lazy import inside `_fr13_replay_durable_ab`. INPUTS per (layer,row): A_log=layer.A_log, dt_bias=layer.dt_bias, a/b = flat (1,M,HV) gather of the raw_a/raw_b rings, q (1,M,KH,DK) = zeros (q-side never touches durable state; native's `b_q*scale` is irrelevant to it), k (1,M,KH,DK)/v (1,M,HV,DV) = flat gathers of the k/v rings at the SAME chain node indices the replay reads, initial_state = the CLONED h0 (1,HV,V,K), cu_seqlens=[0,M] (B=1 varlen), use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True (matches replay; native does l2norm in-kernel on raw k). OUTPUT durable state: with `inplace_final_state=False`, native allocates a FRESH `final_state = q.new_empty(T,HV,V,K)` and writes the per-token cumulative recurrent state into it (kernel lines 181-184, INPLACE_FINAL_STATE=False branch); H_native_seq = final_state[M-1]. The math basis is line-for-line identical to our `_gdn_node_step` RAW_GATING path (softplus threshold 20, b_g=-exp(A_log)*softplus, beta=sigmoid(raw_b), l2norm q/k, state*=exp(b_g), b_v-=sum(state*k), b_v*=beta, state+=b_v*k), so a faithful replay gives ~0 and any nonzero is the codegen/fp-order durable diff being measured. output_scale = head_k_dim**-0.5 == native scale.
d.observeOnlyProof: The native arm NEVER touches the served bank/stream: (1) initial_state is a `.clone()` of `bank[h0_row]` (detached fp32 copy), never the bank tensor; (2) k/v/a/b are `index_select(...).unsqueeze(0).contiguous()` gathers = fresh tensors, never the served rings; (3) the native call passes `inplace_final_state=False` → native's INPLACE branch (which would write ssm_state_indices rows in the served bank) is NOT taken; it writes a fresh `q.new_empty(T,HV,V,K)` (kernel lines 181-184), AND no `ssm_state_indices`/`num_accepted_tokens` are passed (IS_CONTINUOUS_BATCHING/IS_SPEC_DECODING both False) so there is no bank-row write path at all; (4) H_ours is READ from the bank (`bank[final_row]`), never written. CPU test `test_native_ab_runs_observe_only_and_records` asserts `torch.equal(bank, bank_before)` after the call (served bank byte-untouched) and `test_resolver_default_off_no_op` asserts the bank is untouched and native is never called when OFF. The served replay-launch path itself is unchanged (proven: `_fr13_replay_launch(` count == 2, intact; OFF-reduced committer == HEAD byte-for-byte).
d.assertPrevention: YES — kernel-valid for all cloned geometries by construction (no catch-around-assert). The accepted chain is a LINEAR sequence M=acc_len+1 passed as ONE B=1 varlen sequence: cu_seqlens=[0,M], q.shape[0]==1, and NO ssm_state_indices / NO num_accepted_tokens. Per the heuristics (fused_sigmoid_gating.py:17-21) this gives USE_INITIAL_STATE=True, IS_VARLEN=True, IS_CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=False, IS_SPEC_DECODING=False, INPLACE_FINAL_STATE=False. This DODGES the reduced-row spec-decode index path (ssm_state_indices[i_n*stride+i_t], num_accepted_tokens-1 column math) that produced the M5/M1 reduced-row tree-slice geometry which device-asserted in causal_conv1d_update in the conv/scan A/B. Native's only hard asserts are NK==1 (K=128, BK=next_pow2(128)=128 → NK=1, always true) and "batch size 1 when cu_seqlens" (we always pass B=1 flattened) — both satisfied by construction. So no cloned geometry can reach an assert; nothing is caught (per fe0af022, a device assert poisons the CUDA context and is unrecoverable, so prevention-not-catch was required). The arm-fail try/except guards only Python-level errors (e.g. import) and records FR13_RDAB_STAGE=arm-fail; it does not, and cannot, recover from a device assert.
